info.title: Agrimate API
info.description: All money is integer paise, sent as decimal strings. Times are UTC ISO-8601.

acceptContract.description: Must be true: the buyer accepts the active contract terms.

organicCertId.description: Claiming organic requires naming a verified, unexpired certificate.

acceptContract.description: Must be true: the buyer accepts the active contract terms.

capturedAt.description: Device time corrected by the server offset from the session response.

noCoLoadingAttested.description: Must be true for every trip.

amountPaise.description: Rupee-free: integer paise. Omit to pay the next open tranche exactly.

role.description: Required only the first time a phone signs up. ADMIN accounts cannot self-register.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 computed on the device before upload.

captureToken.description: Mandatory for SELF_CERT_VIDEO. Issued only by the in-app recorder flow, so gallery files have no way in.

multipart.description: Use a resumable multipart upload (recommended for video on poor networks).

ratePaisePerKm.description: Paise per km, as an integer string.

noCoLoadingAccepted.description: Must be true: strict ban on carrying other commercial goods with agricultural produce.
